title: MOTO RUSH
one_line: Race a 3D superbike through traffic, upgrade five bikes and beat three new challenges every day.
how_to_play: Touch the left or right side of the screen to steer, hold NITRO to boost, and pass close to cars for near-miss bonuses.
description: Ride beyond limits in a 3D motorcycle rush. Dodge endless traffic across sunset coast, neon night, desert and alpine roads. Unlock five bikes, from the Rover 250 to the Phantom X hyperbike and the MotoRush RR factory race bike, upgrade the engine, nitro, tyres and brakes, chain near-miss combos, take on three new Daily Challenges every day, and keep your Daily Run streak alive.
